description: Spawn a scoped swarm child (POST /v1/agents/{parent_agent_id}/spawn). Requires root LITHTRIX_API_KEY.

agent_name.description: Optional child display name; server generates swarm-{uuid8} if omitted.

issue_ephemeral_passport.description: When true, mint ephemeral passport for the child agent.

parent_agent_id.description: Your agent UUID (from lithtrix_register or GET /v1/me). Inferred from /v1/me when omitted.

scope.description: Scoped sub-key permission for the child.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional key expiry hint stored on the key row.

name: lithtrix_spawn
